Columba collects your device's location (precise or approximate, depending on what you grant) to:

• Show your position on the map
• Calculate distance and direction to contacts
• Share your location with contacts you choose, for as long as you choose
• Power Group Tracker: automatically send your location to the group host you choose, who may share it with your group
• Choose an area for offline maps
• Sort nearby interfaces by distance

Group Tracker and active Location Sharing sessions can also keep sending while the app is closed or not in use. When Group Tracker is on, Columba also receives locations shared by your group. Location is encrypted and sent only to the contacts or group host you choose. It is never stored on a central server. You can stop sharing at any time.
